info: v6 -> v7 publication differences that are DECIDED to be acceptable, with the reason.
They are still compared and still REPORTED (verdict ACCEPTED, with the reason printed);
they simply do not count towards the exit code. Nothing here is silently normalised away.
Override the path with --accepted=<file>; pass --accepted=none to compare with no
acceptances at all (the strictest run, useful to re-check a decision).
Adding an entry is a DECISION, not a convenience: it says 'the published bytes differ and
the websites are still correct'. Record who decided it and why.

MEDIA URL PREFIX is handled by the `media` NORMALISER, not by an entry here: v6 and v7 serve media from different locations (/dedalo/media_mib vs /dedalo/media), so only the prefix differs while the filename half is identical. run_parity.sh enables --normalize=media by default; the affected columns report as NORMALIZED(media), never as MATCH. Decided 2026-08-12.

unordered_json_columns.indexation: Computed inverse index (component_relation_index / dd96). The set of entries must match exactly and is compared element by element; only the ORDER is ignored. v6 itself is not deterministic here - the column is calculated per publication from a PostgreSQL query with no total order, so v6 emits a different sequence on different runs. Decided 2026-08-12.
unordered_json_columns.games.indexations: Computed inverse index (component_relation_index / dd96) — the plural-named twin of `indexation`, on the games table. Same class of difference as the `indexation` entry above and decided by the same rule: the column is COMPUTED per publication from a PostgreSQL inverse query with no total order, so v6 itself emits a different sequence on different runs. Verified order-only: every differing cell is an exact permutation of the v6 value — same element count, same elements, compared one by one; only the sequence is ignored. Decided 2026-08-12.
unordered_json_columns.games.parents: Computed inverse parents (dd47) — the set of a record's parents, not an ordered path. Same class of difference as the `indexation` entry above and decided by the same rule: the column is COMPUTED per publication from a PostgreSQL inverse query with no total order, so v6 itself emits a different sequence on different runs. Verified order-only: every differing cell is an exact permutation of the v6 value — same element count, same elements, compared one by one; only the sequence is ignored. Decided 2026-08-12.
unordered_json_columns.games.indexations_related: Computed inverse index (component_relation_index / dd96) resolved PER SOURCE — the cell holds one json array per referencing record, imploded with ' | '. The SOURCE GROUPS are compared in order and must match exactly; only the entry order WITHIN a group is ignored. Same rule and same reason as the `indexation` entry: the set is calculated per publication from a PostgreSQL query with no total order, so v6 itself emits a different sequence on different runs. Verified: every differing cell is an exact per-group permutation — same group count, same entries in each group, compared one by one. Decided 2026-08-13.

accepted_columns.restringidos.space: SCOPED TO THE rt1/restringidos COLUMN ONLY (node hierarchy72). v6 publishes a FABRICATED default map centre ({alt,lat,lon,zoom}) for records with no real geolocation; the v6 publication API strips it again before any website sees it. v7 publishes NULL there, which is the same information without the fiction. Decided 2026-08-12. NOT a blanket acceptance of every column named `space`: on games (node dd1269) v7 emits an OVERSIZED value where v6 emits nothing at all, which is an open defect, not an accepted difference.
accepted_columns.related: v6 writes '' where v7 writes NULL for a column it never populates. NULL is the correct v7 representation for an absent default and the publication API tolerates it. Decided 2026-08-12.
accepted_columns.antropologia.space: Same STUDIO DEFAULT map centre accepted for restringidos.space: v6 publishes the fabricated {"alt":16,"lat":"39.462571","lon":"-0.376295"} camera position the v5/v6 client wrote on every save whether or not anyone touched the map, and the v6 publication API strips it again before any website sees it. v7 publishes NULL — the same information without the fiction. Verified byte-identical to the restringidos value (same lat/lon). Decided 2026-08-12.
accepted_columns.periodos.space: Same STUDIO DEFAULT map centre accepted for restringidos.space: v6 publishes the fabricated {"alt":16,"lat":"39.462571","lon":"-0.376295"} camera position the v5/v6 client wrote on every save whether or not anyone touched the map, and the v6 publication API strips it again before any website sees it. v7 publishes NULL — the same information without the fiction. Verified byte-identical to the restringidos value (same lat/lon). Decided 2026-08-12.

accepted_schema.reason: v6 tables carry an AUTO_INCREMENT surrogate `id`; v7 keys rows by (section_id, lang) directly. Part of the update, not visible to the publication API.
v7 promotes the natural key to the PRIMARY KEY instead of a secondary unique index. Same uniqueness guarantee, stricter declaration.
v7 widens the language column; every value that fit before still fits.
The v7 SQL generator does not render field_enum as a MySQL ENUM. The published VALUES are unchanged; only the column declaration differs.
